newsitem.title: USA: CSCE to raise margins on March "C" coffee futures.
newsitem.headline: CSCE to raise margins on March "C" coffee futures.

text.p: Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange said Thursday it will raise margins on the March 1997 "C" coffee contracts by $1,000 to $4,500, effective February 14.
The margin on May 1997 "C" coffee contracts will remain at $3,000, and all other coffee contracts will be stay at $2,500, the exchange said in a statement.
The changes comes just two days after the exchange raised the the March and May 1997 margins by $750 and the margins on all other contracts by $250.

In addition, CSCE said that as of February 14 it will increase trade margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the March 1997 and May 1997 contracts by $1,300, to $3,500. Margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the March 1997 contract and all other contract months other than the 1997 May contract will increase by $1,300 to $3,000.

Additionally, margins on all straddle and arbitrage transactions involving the May 1997 contract and all other contract months other than the spot March 1997 contract will increase by $300, to $1,500. The exchange will require a minimum of $1,000 on all straddle and arbitrage transactions not involving the March 1997 and May 1997 contracts.
For customers who are not exchange members or a member of the trade, margins will be 140 percent above trade rates, CSCE said.
